title: Fix tax rounding in order total calculation

ecr_overview.title: Fix tax rounding in order total calculation
ecr_overview.description: Correct the order total calculation so tax is rounded per currency minor unit after discounts rather than before, keeping the authorised amount equal to the displayed order total.

change_classification.summary: ECR-2026-008 is a backend change in the Payments domain affecting Currency Conversion, Order Management. 1 file(s) are declared on the change and 3 candidate component(s) were identified.

matched_requirements.title: Order Checkout Flow
matched_requirements.description: The checkout journey shall validate the cart, reserve stock, request payment authorisation and confirm the order in a single orchestrated flow.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Order Total Calculation with Taxes
matched_requirements.description: Order totals shall be computed as line items plus tax minus discounts, rounded per currency minor-unit rules before payment authorisation.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Invoice Generation and Numbering
matched_requirements.description: A gap-free, sequential invoice number shall be issued per legal entity on order completion, with amounts formatted for the invoice currency.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-012 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
matched_requirements.description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
matched_requirements.description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
matched_requirements.description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Refund Currency Parity
matched_requirements.description: Refunds shall be issued in the original transaction currency using the original conversion rate so that the customer is made whole.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Order Cancellation
matched_requirements.description: Customers shall cancel an order before dispatch; cancellation voids the authorisation or triggers a full refund when funds were captured.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-006 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Transactional Email Notifications
matched_requirements.description: Order confirmation, refund confirmation and security alerts shall be delivered by templated email in the customer's locale within 60 seconds.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-011 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: User Profile Management
matched_requirements.description: Customers shall view and edit profile details, contact preferences and the address book from the profile page of the portal.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-009 identified in the change.

sections.title: Executive Summary
ECR Overview
sections.body: Correct the order total calculation so tax is rounded per currency minor unit after discounts rather than before, keeping the authorised amount equal to the displayed order total.

data.title: Fix tax rounding in order total calculation
data.description: Correct the order total calculation so tax is rounded per currency minor unit after discounts rather than before, keeping the authorised amount equal to the displayed order total.

sections.title: Change Classification
sections.body: ECR-2026-008 is a backend change in the Payments domain affecting Currency Conversion, Order Management. 1 file(s) are declared on the change and 3 candidate component(s) were identified.

data.summary: ECR-2026-008 is a backend change in the Payments domain affecting Currency Conversion, Order Management. 1 file(s) are declared on the change and 3 candidate component(s) were identified.

sections.title: Affected Requirements
sections.body: Searched 30 requirements across traceability, semantic and keyword channels and matched 10. Strongest match is REQ-1010 (Order Checkout Flow) at 100% relevance.

requirements.title: Order Checkout Flow
requirements.description: The checkout journey shall validate the cart, reserve stock, request payment authorisation and confirm the order in a single orchestrated flow.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Order Total Calculation with Taxes
requirements.description: Order totals shall be computed as line items plus tax minus discounts, rounded per currency minor-unit rules before payment authorisation.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Invoice Generation and Numbering
requirements.description: A gap-free, sequential invoice number shall be issued per legal entity on order completion, with amounts formatted for the invoice currency.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-012 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
requirements.description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
requirements.description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
requirements.description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Refund Currency Parity
requirements.description: Refunds shall be issued in the original transaction currency using the original conversion rate so that the customer is made whole.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Order Cancellation
requirements.description: Customers shall cancel an order before dispatch; cancellation voids the authorisation or triggers a full refund when funds were captured.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-006 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Transactional Email Notifications
requirements.description: Order confirmation, refund confirmation and security alerts shall be delivered by templated email in the customer's locale within 60 seconds.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-011 identified in the change.

requirements.title: User Profile Management
requirements.description: Customers shall view and edit profile details, contact preferences and the address book from the profile page of the portal.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-009 identified in the change.

sections.title: Historical Defect Analysis
sections.body: Searched 38 historical defects and found 10 related to this change (historical risk index 1.00). No recurring root-cause pattern emerged. Highest-risk components: CMP-005, CMP-006, CMP-012.

defects.title: Order total mismatch versus authorised amount
defects.root_cause: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-006) as the current change; root cause 'Ordering of operations'; reopened 1 time(s).

defects.title: Rounding error on JPY payments
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-005) as the current change; root cause 'Currency minor-unit handling'; escaped to production.

defects.title: Invoice amount formatted with wrong currency symbol
defects.root_cause: Formatter defaulted to the locale currency.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-012) as the current change; root cause 'Localisation'; escaped to production.

defects.title: Currency service returned rates with wrong precision
defects.root_cause: Float rounding in the rate serialiser.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-005) as the current change; root cause 'Floating point precision'; escaped to production; reopened 1 time(s).

defects.title: Currency conversion failed for unsupported currencies
defects.root_cause: Missing guard clause for unknown currency codes in convert().
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-005) as the current change; root cause 'Missing validation'; escaped to production; reopened 1 time(s).

defects.title: Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes
defects.root_cause: Validation rule checked length only, not the currency catalogue.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-004) as the current change; root cause 'Incomplete validation rule'; escaped to production; reopened 2 time(s).

defects.title: Refund service failed after payment validation change
defects.root_cause: Shared validation library changed without refund regression run.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-007) as the current change; root cause 'Shared library contract break'; escaped to production.

defects.title: Duplicate authorisation on client retry
defects.root_cause: Idempotency key not persisted before the acquirer call.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-003) as the current change; root cause 'Idempotency gap'; escaped to production; reopened 1 time(s).

defects.title: Stale FX rate applied after cache refresh failure
defects.root_cause: Refresh failure swallowed, no rate-age assertion.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-005) as the current change; root cause 'Silent error handling'; escaped to production.

defects.title: Transaction insert failed after schema migration
defects.root_cause: Backward-incompatible migration deployed before the service change.
defects.reason: Matched on same component (CMP-008) as the current change; root cause 'Schema migration ordering'; escaped to production; reopened 1 time(s).

decisions.text: Decision: UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY must be raised before funds are reserved, not after. Confirmed with treasury that no reservation may exist for a rejected currency.
